title: Modal
overview: A blocking layer that takes attention until they respond or dismiss.
apply_when: They must decide or finish before returning to the page: confirm, short form, important failure.
not_when: Low-priority status (toast), in-page expand (accordion), side sheet that should not trap the whole page (drawer), or a tiny confirm next to the control (popconfirm).

vs.why: side panel; page behind may stay usable
confirm next to the control, not a page modal

role.overview: A blocking layer they must finish or dismiss.
A blocking layer that must be acknowledged before anything else.

size.overview: Highest in the size hierarchy — the easiest to hit.
size.apply_when: The view's main instance, or full-width on a small viewport.
size.not_when: A dense toolbar or a third option next to the main control.

size.apply_when: Ordinary use in forms, pages, and chrome.
size.not_when: The only control on a mobile screen that should span the width.

size.overview: Lowest in the size hierarchy — densest.
size.apply_when: Inline or chrome that sits beside content.
size.not_when: The page's primary instance, or a control under 44×44.

composition.overview: A name, a body, and footer actions.
composition.not_when: A blank overlay with only an X.

composition.overview: A short form lives in the modal. Submit must actually submit.
composition.not_when: A complex multi-section form (not in a modal).

state.overview: The overlay is not shown. The trigger stays available.
state.apply_when: The page is the place they work.
state.not_when: The overlay is still in the tab order while hidden.

state.overview: The overlay is shown and owns the conversation.
state.apply_when: They must see or finish this layer.
state.not_when: Content behind stays fully interactive when this overlay must trap.

state.overview: Focus is inside the overlay. Must stay visible.
state.apply_when: Tab, open, or restoring after a nested popover.
state.not_when: Focus dumped on the document behind.

accessibility.overview: The overlay has a name AT can speak (title or aria-label).
accessibility.not_when: The only name is a decorative icon.

accessibility.overview: The focused control inside stays visible.
accessibility.apply_when: Keyboard or AT focus is in the overlay.

accessibility.overview: A blocking overlay exposes modal so AT does not read the page behind.
accessibility.apply_when: A modal that traps until dismiss.
accessibility.not_when: A non-blocking drawer or popconfirm marked as modal.

accessibility.overview: After close, focus returns to the trigger.
accessibility.apply_when: The overlay opened from a control that still exists.
accessibility.not_when: Focus dumped on the document body.

keyboard.overview: Escape dismisses when dismiss is allowed.
keyboard.apply_when: The overlay is open and cancel is valid.
keyboard.not_when: Escape submits or destroys work with no confirm.

keyboard.overview: Tab cycles the overlay's controls. A modal does not leak to the page.
keyboard.not_when: Tab reaches the page behind a blocking modal.

keyboard.overview: Enter runs the default action when a default exists.
keyboard.apply_when: A confirm or a focused control.
keyboard.not_when: Enter submits a complex form the person has not finished.
